children: Pinterest hits an all-time high of 661 million global monthly active users in 3Q, a 10% increase year over year. The company says its AI-driven visual search and shopping tools are making the platform more valuable for users and advertisers. Global average revenue per user rises just 1% to $1.80, but the U.S. and Canada market shows stronger monetization with ARPU growing 10% to $8.38. The gap between user growth and global ARPU growth reflects Pinterest's heavier expansion in lower-monetized international markets, where Rest of World MAUs climb 13% to 394 million.
